lines.say: A text from my own number: open the door, it's me.
The text said, open the door, it is me. It came from my own number.
The old man read it and went pale.
He said, your wife never texts from your number.
There is only one door here that opens from the outside.
I turned. The cot with my name had its blanket pulled back. Still warm.
Three taps came from inside the wall.
Then a voice. Mine. Open the door.
